title: Decision record (.rms/decisions/<sha>.json), spec v0
description: What the gate decided about one draft. The kernel executes nothing else; a gate line without evidence is a fail; verdict accept is applied without a human in the loop.

verdict.description: accept = the kernel applies the correction as its own commit, no human click (point 7); escalate = decision record to the architects; defer; reject

pass.description: null = not reached because an earlier line failed

evidence.description: the evidence field(s) named in docs/spec/gate.md for this line

differ_before.description: path of the SARIF report on the author's commit

differ_after.description: path of the SARIF report on the candidate

trial_runs.description: CI or local run ids for G3, G4, G8

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 over the canonical JSON of every other field; key held by the kernel only

applied_commit.description: sha of the system's own commit when verdict = accept; null otherwise
